widget_mechanic: User must select K-of-N checkboxes inside one facet group, where the facet contains similar-looking decoys (e.g. Open-Box vs Refurbished, Linux vs Linux Lite). Agent must pick the exact subset and exclude lookalikes.

source_inspiration.instruction: Show me the most popular open-source software on SourceForge that runs on Linux and macOS, belongs to the category of “Agentic AI”, is licensed under MIT, and has a production/stable development status.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [6.4] Fine-grained grounding error in the Operating Systems filter modal — agent picked the “Linux Lite” sub-checkbox by mistake instead of the top-level “Linux” facet, and never confirmed/cleared the wrong selection.
